angle: Which products are genuinely worth their current price — and which to skip.

reviews.title: Safety Glasses Virtua CCS Protective
pros: Corded ear plug control system keeps hearing protection tethered to eyewear — no more lost plugs on job sites
Removable foam gasket seals out dust and debris while remaining fully replaceable when worn
Anti-fog coating holds up in humid conditions where cheaper lenses fog within minutes

reviews.title: OXO Brew Conical Burr Coffee
pros: 38mm stainless steel conical burrs deliver consistent grounds across 15 settings, from fine espresso to coarse French press
One-touch timer with automatic shutoff—set it once, get the same dose every morning
Removable hopper and grind container rinse clean in seconds; no brush required for daily upkeep
